decision_authority.policy: MRX continuous quality-gated publication and two-image article creative directive

title: Understanding the True Value of Your Mineral Interests
findings: Complete current MDX SHA-256 is 979b72c2a98b2f35799d02bf6ef8da2941ec6dae59bc325ad6c6047a08f39c9b; all 5 declared sources passed live access review.

MRX claims remain bounded to the current methodology, Sell Mineral Rights, How It Works, FAQ, and terms pages. The article distinguishes a directional range from transaction consideration, provisional owner net, and personal decision threshold; labels uncertainty; preserves professional handoffs; and does not turn a first-party framework into an owner-specific conclusion.

The article uses no fabricated owners, properties, buyers, contracts, prices, acreage, ownership decimals, production, reserves, forecasts, tax results, offers, testimonials, success rates, or owner-specific title, legal, tax, accounting, appraisal, investment, or transaction conclusions.

sources_inspected.label: Mineral Rights Xchange, Published DCF Methodology (accessed 2026-08-12)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current MRX methodology describes a directional discounted-cash-flow review with stated production, decline, operator, royalty, commodity, discount, title, acreage, and offer-term inputs and presents the result as a range under assumptions.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the page only for the dated directional-range, stated-input, stated-assumption, sensitivity, and professional-limit framework; it does not establish owner-specific title, reserves, value, tax treatment, suitability, or a transaction result.
